QuestInfo.name: Unexpected Guests
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9270058##k and her daddy were both surprised to see that most of the guests brought their kids with them to the birthday party. There are no gifts prepared for little kids, but #b#p9270058##k doesn't want to send them home empty-handed. She must think of something very quickly.
QuestInfo.1: Since the adults got #b#t4000470#s#k, #b#t4000474#s#k would be perfect for the little guests. Now it's a matter of gathering enough #b#t4000474#s#k and bringing them to #b#p9270058##k before the party ends.
QuestInfo.2: Just before the party ended, the kids got their surprise gifts. Though #b#p9270058##k had to rush to get them ready, the kids were overjoyed.
